decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost extension of the established offer, has stayed visible on the website, and belongs to the firm's publicly stated promise of fast delivery, so dropping it would undercut that commitment.
The seventy-two-hour program is demanding to run, but it is tied to the firm's public fast-response positioning, and any weak results can still be blamed on temporary capacity or market conditions.
The express program for doors and gates has had its own page for two years, which shows visible commitment and makes it central to the service direction the firm has announced.

The online ordering and digital services platform carries high sunk investment and is central to the firm's announced advisory and service direction, so abandoning it would write off that investment and expose the earlier decision.

Commitment to the fire and smoke protection door grew when it was moved to its own page in 2024, and it replaced the dropped fire-resistant door C, which makes it the firm's chosen fire-safety product.
